title: Village Hall Booking System Task Board
originalRequest: Establish the business logic rules for the automated scheduling and cancellation subsystem.
latestMessage: Establish the business logic rules for the automated scheduling and cancellation subsystem.

steps.title: Clarify cancellation and refund policy tier logic
steps.instruction: Please define the exact automated refund percentages and threshold limits for booking cancellations (e.g., full refund if cancelled more than 7 days prior, 50% refund between 48 hours and 7 days, and 0% refund under 48 hours) so that we can program the billing engine rules.
steps.acceptance: Receipt of a documented set of rules outlining the cancellation window thresholds and corresponding refund percentages to be applied to user accounts.
